# ScribeCat 0.25.7

## Fixed
- Restore the minimized inline PDF viewer when its split-view pane is closed.
- Close the PDF split pane without closing the owning Markdown note.
- Fix PDF all-pages inline view height so the thumbnail grid can grow and scroll naturally.
- Keep PowerPoint multi-slide layout and height unchanged.

## Docker
- Publish `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.7`.
- Pin the Server Edition Compose defaults to `0.25.7`.
